answer: Zenith bridge toll — each identity pays a $7 toll to drive one crate of nectar across the toll bridge at solar noon, when the sun stands at its zenith over the plaza. The bridge camera photographs the crossing and the plaza log records plate and time; a crate that never crossed has no photograph, and a receipt copied from a morning run shows a long shadow where noon shows none, so both are struck. One crossing vouches for one crate, and a farm with no truck on the bridge has no nectar to sell.
